title: Spatial Studio · Reality check
changes: Fixed head-following XR interface: panel now remains in the local room reference space, with recentering and header dragging.
Added visible controller/hand pointing rays, target markers, pinch and trigger selection, plus a private inventory view inside XR.
Added an explicit camera-readiness diagnostic to distinguish passthrough visualization from actual readable pixels.
Added Aholo Lux3D, OpenAI, Gemini and Grok/xAI to admin-only model connections.
API keys may be kept in current-tab RAM or saved encrypted in the Ubuntu vault; new read-only authentication checks avoid inference jobs.
Added Meshy balance lookup where provided, Meta token usage tracking and a separate FREE LAB rolling request-quota meter.
SAM 3.1 detected bounding boxes can be saved as private JPEG object crops, not transparent segmentation masks.
Replaced browser-native scan consent and provider/model selects with floating in-app controls.
